newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel estimates raised.

text.p: -- PaineWebber analyst John Lazlo said he raised his third quarter earnings per share estimate for Intel Corp to $1.26 from $1.09. A year earlier the company earned $1.05 a share.
-- Raised third quarter revenue forecast to $4.9 billion from $4.6 billion, reflecting six percent sequential growth.
-- Raised full-year 1996 earnings per share estimate to $4.82 from $4.45, versus $3.98 in 1995.
-- Raised full-year 1997 estimate to $5.65 per share from $5.40.
-- Lazlo, in a morning market note, cited Intel's statement that third quarter earnings will exceed expectations.
-- "Growth is evidently being driven by strong PC unit sales, which are generating higher unit demand for microprocessors and chip sets," he wrote.
-- "Intel's business momentum could continue to result in further EPS estimate increases."
-- His new estimate for the full-year 1996 implies fourth quarter earnings per share of $1.38, compared with a previous estimate of $1.17, versus $0.98 a year earlier.
